memory_candidates: Scoped notation defined via `open scoped X` in a Lean file is file-local -- it does not propagate to importing files even within the same enclosing namespace. Files using `⇓`/other scoped InferenceSystem-family notation in a *type signature* (not just inside a proof term fed to grind) need their own `open scoped InferenceSystem` line.

Anonymous instance-implicit arguments (e.g. `[Std.Symm m.r]` without a name) cannot be targeted by Lean's named-argument syntax (`(instSymm := ...)`); only explicitly named instance binders (`[instRefl : Std.Refl m.r]`) support that pattern. Fallback: `haveI : <Class> := h` then apply directly.
